title: Goal
description: One goal (a time-boxed block with weight, calorie, protein and step targets). The web app keeps an ordered list: localStorage goa:goals (array) and db doc state/goals as {list:[Goal,...]}. The active goal is the LAST goal with done=false (activeGoal); if all are done, the last goal. History is kept: finished goals stay in the list with done=true and endKg.

id.description: 'g' + Date.now() in base 36 (e.g. 'gm3k1x2a'). The provisional placeholder uses 'g0'.

provisional.description: True only on the in-memory placeholder created before setup (provisionalGoal). saveGoals deletes this flag; it should never be persisted.

name.description: What the person is aiming at, e.g. 'Summer'. Onboarding defaults by type: Lean out, Recomp, Build muscle, Feel better.

why.description: One line on why it matters. Free text, may be personal.

type.description: Goal kind. Onboarding writes lose|recomp|muscle|health. The provisional goal uses recomp. The 'Next goal' button branches on 'gain' and 'maintain' but nothing in r14 writes those (legacy or reserved). Code treats a missing type as 'lose'. Only 'lose' gets the planned maintenance week (+500 kcal); only 'muscle' flips the weekly-review calorie rule to increases.

start.description: First day of the goal (weight timeline and projection run from here).

due.description: Last day of the plan. Must be after start (gSave refuses otherwise).

event.description: The day itself (wedding, trip). Drives the countdown. gSave clears it unless it is on or within 30 days after due.

trainStart.description: Training schedule start. Defaults to start when missing (applyGoal). Lets a restarted block begin Phase 1 without moving the weight timeline. Not set by the 'Next goal' button.

startKg.description: Start weight in kg. When null or 0, applyGoal uses the first logged weight on or after start.

targetKg.description: Target weight in kg. When null or 0, treated as equal to the start weight.

endKg.description: Latest logged weight when the goal was finished. Only present on done goals.

kcal.description: Daily calorie target (kcal). Code fallback 2200 when 0 or missing; provisional goal uses 2000.

protein.description: Daily protein target in grams. Code fallbacks differ: 180 in plan(k) and gSave, 120 in checkList and the table colors. Provisional goal uses 120.

steps.description: Starting daily step target. Used for the default plan's phase steps. When a saved plan exists, editing this shifts every phase's steps by the same delta.

homeFirst.description: Use the original 'home first' layout (homeFirstPlan) instead of makePlan.

done.description: Finished goals stay in the list for history.

milestones.description: Dated tasks and blood tests. Shown in the checklist on that day, on the phase timeline, in the blood-test table, and optionally as calendar reminders.

k.description: 'lab' = book or take bloods (sensitive medical data), 'task' = generic milestone.
